dedupe_keys.name: electrical half hourly raw and cleaned datasets for great britain from 2008 11 05

description: The ESPENI deposit provides a half-hourly Great Britain electricity series beginning 5 November 2008. Zenodo lists a public 94 MB CSV at version 8.0.8 under CC BY-NC 4.0. The provider describes demand, generation, storage and interconnector fields assembled from Elexon and National Grid data, with ISO 8601 time stamps and units in newer column names. Such historic series can calibrate electricity-demand, dispatch or interconnection scenarios. The description documents known version changes, including a 2021 interconnector error corrected in later versions and a 2023 note that the raw version was dropped for the time being, despite the broad record title. The exact latest columns and end date were not checked from the CSV. Upstream operator rights remain separate from Zenodo’s noncommercial licence claim. No related catalogue record explicitly names this ESPENI release. The file was not downloaded, and no historic values or cleaning choices were reproduced.
name: Electrical half hourly raw and cleaned datasets for Great Britain from 2008-11-05
